environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on EKS in namespace 'notifications-staging'. Cluster uses Cilium CNI with CiliumNetworkPolicy applied at namespace level. Policy spec: endpointSelector matches all pods in namespace, egress rules allow DNS (kube-dns on port 53), SQS VPC endpoint (CIDR 10.0.48.0/24 port 443), RDS cluster endpoint (10.0.96.0/24 port 5432). All other egress denied including link-local 169.254.169.254/32. Ingress limited to ALB controller pods on port 8080. Additionally, the admin panel responses include header 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src self; script-src nonce-{random}; style-src self unsafe-inline; img-src self data:; connect-src self' set via Spring Security filter chain with SecureRandom nonce generation per request. The CSP reporting endpoint at /csp-report logs violations. Pod securityContext sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops all capabilities.

config.csp_header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'nonce-{random}'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'
